terms_clauses.text: HSBC Premier Destinations: 1 Complimentary Night’s Stay Promotion (“Promotion”) Terms and Conditions HSBC Premier Destinations: 1 Complimentary Night’s Stay Promotion (“Promotion”) Terms and Conditions | HSBC Singapore Skip to main content Latest Promotions Celebrate the Season Campaign 2026 Convert and Win Campaign 2026 HSBC Premier Destinations: 1 Complimentary Night’s Stay Indulge in the Finest Campaign 2026 HSBC x SPM Credit Card Sign Up Promotion Travel with Points Live+ Dining Programme Exclusive Cashback Promotion Spend Campaigns Dining Travel & Leisure Lifestyle & Shopping Daily Spend Dempsey Rewards Home&Away T&Cs HSBC Premier Destinations: 1 Complimentary Night’s Stay Promotion (“Promotion”) Terms and Conditions The Promotion is valid for customers who hold a primary HSBC Premier Mastercard Credit Card issued by HSBC Bank (Singapore) Limited (“ HSBC “) (such HSBC Credit Card, an “ Eligible Card “), as a credit cardholder whose credit account is in good standing with HSBC over the entire Promotional Period (as defined below) and at the time of fulfillment (as determined by HSBC at its reasonable discretion) and who fulfills these terms and conditions (such customer, a “ Cardholder “) shall be eligible to participate in the Promotion. The Promotion is valid for hotel bookings made from 1 September to 30 December 2026 (“Promotional Period”), and hotel stays must be completed by 31 December 2026. This Promotion is only valid for bookings at participating hotel properties, destinations and room types, as specified from time to time, and is subject to availability and blackout dates (which may vary by hotel property). The Promotion is subject to limited allocation and availability on a first-come, first-served basis. The Promotion is limited to one (1) redemption per Cardholder during the Promotional Period across all participating hotel properties and destinations. Each redemption entitles the Cardholder to book two (2) consecutive nights in an eligible room type at a participating hotel property, where the second (2nd) night is complimentary (the “Promotion Benefit”), subject to these Promotional Terms and Conditions. To enjoy this Promotion, the Cardholder must make a reservation for a minimum of two (2) consecutive nights at a participating hotel property in an eligible room type during the Promotional Period, and complete the stay by 31 December 2026. The Cardholder will be charged the applicable “Pay 1 Night” rate for the first night (as communicated by the Service Provider at the time of booking), together with any applicable taxes and/or service charges. The second (2nd) night is complimentary, and no room charge, taxes and/or service charges will apply to the second night. Any incidental charges (e.g. minibar, room service, telephone, laundry, damages) and any other charges not expressly included in the Promotion must be paid by the Cardholder directly to the hotel. The complimentary second night cannot be exchanged for cash, refunded, or used to offset other charges. Breakfast for two (2) is included only where stated for the eligible room type. For the avoidance of doubt, where the Promotion Benefit is void or forfeited under these Terms and Conditions, the Cardholder will be charged the “Pay 1 Night” rate for two (2) nights (i.e. 2 x “Pay 1 Night” rate), together with any applicable taxes and/or service charges. All hotel bookings under this Promotion are managed by Mastercard Concierge Service (trading as Ten Lifestyle Group Plc) (the “Service Provider”). By submitting a booking request to the Service Provider, the Cardholder authorises the Service Provider to collect, use and disclose the Cardholder’s personal data to relevant third parties (including the hotel) for the purposes of processing and managing the booking, in accordance with applicable law and the Service Provider’s privacy notice/policy (as applicable). Hotel bookings made via any other reservation platforms will not be eligible for this Promotion. Customer’s booking information and Eligible Card details provided to the Service Provider will be verified upon check-in at the participating hotel property. To participate in this Promotion, the Cardholder needs to perform the following steps: Register for a Mastercard Travel & Lifestyle Services (“MTLS”) account at https://travel.mastercard.com using Full name as per NRIC/Passport (The name used for MTLS registration will be used for the hotel booking) An Eligible Card Make your hotel booking via Mastercard Concierge Service Hotline: +65 3129 1241 or 18007231416. Provide the Service Provider with your travel dates, guest name(s), preferred bed type, and Eligible Card details. The Service Provider will confirm your eligibility and, if eligible, will proceed to make the reservation with the hotel, subject to room availability and black-out dates. The Cardholder who made the booking must be present for check-in and throughout the stay. Upon check-out at the hotel property, on-site payment must be made with an Eligible Card. If this requirement is not met, the Promotion Benefit will be void and the Cardholder will be charged the “Pay 1 Night” rate for two (2) nights (i.e. 2 x “Pay 1 Night” rate), together with any applicable taxes and/or service charges and incidental charges. All reservations must be guaranteed by an Eligible Card at the time of booking, or the reservation will be automatically released. Hotel check-in time is at 3pm and check-out time is at 12pm. The Promotion is non-transferable and is not valid with ongoing promotions, discounts, vouchers, member privileges unless otherwise stated. In accordance with the hotel’s cancellation policy, cancellations received less than 7 days prior to arrival date are subject to 100% charge, based on the “Pay 1 Night” rate for two (2) nights (i.e. 2 x “Pay 1 Night” rate), together with any applicable taxes and/or service charges. Failure to arrive on the scheduled check-in date without prior cancellation in accordance with the hotel’s cancellation policy will be considered a no-show and will be subject to 100% charge, based on the “Pay 1 Night” rate for two (2) nights (i.e. 2 x “Pay 1 Night” rate), together with any applicable taxes and/or service charges. No refunds will be provided for no-show reservations. General Conditions HSBC is not the supplier of the Promotion Benefit, the accommodation, hotel services or booking services provided under this Promotion and will not accept any liability in relation thereto. HSBC shall not be responsible for injury, pain, loss or damages suffered by any Cardholder in connection with the hotel’s stay redeemed through the Promotion. We may revise these Promotional Terms and Conditions (including but not limited to varying the promotional mechanics under this Promotion or the Promotional Period), or withdraw or alter any part of this Promotion at any time, if it is reasonably necessary to: reflect changes to our operational costs, business operations, systems and processes, our arrangements with third parties or industry or market conditions or practice; give effect to applicable law, rule, regulation or change, requirement, order, notice, recommendation or guidance issued by any regulatory or governmental authority, stock exchange, or body having jurisdiction over us or a court of competent jurisdiction; align with standards or expectations on practices relating to banking and financial services, environmental, social and governance, consumer and investor protection, cyber, digital, technology, operational resilience or taxation; otherwise protect our legitimate interests. Notification of any such changes may be placed at our branches, published on our website, sent through email or mobile, or via any other method we think is reasonably appropriate. Eligibility 3.1.​ This Promotion is only open to Eligible Mari Credit Card Holders. 1 4.​ Promotion Mechanics 4.1.​ To qualify for the Rewards, an Eligible Mari Credit Card Holder must successfully make at least one Eligible Overseas Spend (as defined at Clause 4.2 below). 4.2.​ For the purposes of Clause 4.1 above, an “Eligible Overseas Spend” is a transaction which: 4.3.​ 5.​ (a)​ is made using Mari Credit Card: (i) online through input of Mari Credit Card details; (ii) on Apple Pay / Google Pay; or (iii) physically via a merchant point-of-sale machine; (b)​ is made in foreign currency; (c)​ is not excluded from earning Cashback pursuant to Clause 2.2 of the Terms and Conditions Governing Cashback for Mari Credit Card; (d)​ is charged and posted within a Relevant Month; and (e)​ is not reversed, refunded or cancelled. a maximum of four passengers; and

The 181-unit development is Ascott’s ﬁrst serviced residence in the South. The property oﬀers business and leisure traveler's various apartment choices - spacious studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments featuring contemporary interiors with all the conveniences of home such as a well- equipped kitchen, separate working and living areas, home entertainment system and broadband internet connection. Guests will get to enjoy the recreational areas - swimming pool, and ﬁtness center and cubbies playroom. The property also has 5 function rooms, meeting rooms and serviced oﬃces ideal for business travelers. Somerset Alabang Manila also has 1 F&B outlet, with its newly opened dining concepts, Veranda. Located in a thriving ﬁnancial hub that imbues a cosmopolitan style, Somerset Central Salcedo Makati’s 285 rooms feel like a serene retreat for guests looking for a 'home away from home’. It’s a few minutes' drive away from Greenbelt, Landmark and Glorietta. Get acquainted with the fascinating art display at Ayala Museum, look back in time at Guadalupe Ruins, come for a mass at Greenbelt Chapel, exercise outdoor at Salcedo Park, indulge with gourmet delights at the outdoor Salcedo Saturday Market, and enjoy a night out at Poblacion. The property oﬀers ﬁve types of units ranging from Studio, Studio Premier, One- Bedroom, Two-Bedroom and Three-Bedroom units, oﬀering amenities for business and leisure travellers. All rooms are appointed with ensuite bathroom, split air-conditioning and wireless internet access while the bigger apartments have fully-equipped kitchen, washer and dryer, a pool, fitness centre, and an all-day restaurant. Somerset Millennium Makati rises above the business and commercial district of Legazpi Village, offering a calm retreat within walking distance of the Greenbelt malls, with their wide choice of dining and entertainment options. The property features contemporary residences, from studios to one‑,two‑ and three‑bedroom units, designed for comfort and convenience. Most apartments include fully equipped kitchens, separate living and dining areas, and Wi‑Fi, complemented by a residents’ lounge, fitness centre and outdoor swimming pool for a relaxed and comfortable stay. terms_clauses.text: Complimentary fast-track access to unlock exclusive Brilliant by Langham Member privileges For all Standard Chartered Mastercard cardholders: Brilliant By Langham is a loyalty and experience platform from Langham Hospitality Group. Brilliant combines advanced analytics with a deeply ingrained service culture to bring you immediate benefits and personalized hospitality offerings, from whimsical journeys and cultural immersions to unforgettable wellness and culinary delights. Brilliant’s mission is to create a genuine emotional connection with all members, and make each of them feel special, like the individuals they are. Brilliant invites you to experience more, to feel more, to enjoy that sparkle of Brillance that we know you’ll love. Together, we’ll build new memories and turn them into stories that spark unforgettable feelings with every encounter. Exclusively for Mastercard World Elite, World, Platinum, and Titanium cards issued in selected Asia Pacific markets. Brilliant by Langham makes travel experiences even more precious. When you sign up to Brilliant by Langham , you can enjoy a wide range of member-only privileges. Depending on your tier, enjoy perks like early check-in and late check-out, special Member Rates and F&B discount in over 100 restaurants and bars, room upgrade vouchers and your choice of additional welcome amenities. At every Membership Tier, you’ll discover Brilliant new ways to shine with us. Mastercard cardholders exclusive - join today and go through the following steps to enjoy one-year elite Brilliant by Langham membership tier status: Mastercard World Elite cardholders enjoy exclusive fast track to Brilliant by Langham Ruby Tier Mastercard World cardholders enjoy exclusive fast track to Brilliant by Langham Sapphire Tier Mastercard Platinum and Titanium enjoy exclusive fast track to Brilliant by Langham Diamond Tier Eligible Mastercard Cardholders must request for fast track of Brilliant by Langham membership status per below steps: Visit https://redemption.mastercard.com Sign-Up for a new account using your email and eligible Mastercard card or “Log-In” using an existing account. Click on “ Brilliant by Langham ”. Click on “Get code” to obtain your one-time code. One you retrieve your unique one-time code, visit https://www.brilliantbylangham.com/en/enrolment/statusmatch?partner_code=mastercard&enrolment_code=mastercard If you have registered for a Brilliant by Langham Membership: Input your unique code, then click "SIGN IN" and sign in with your registered email address and password. Fill in the verification code which will be sent to your registered email address inbox and click "SIGN IN". Or If you have not registered for a Brilliant by Langham Membership: Input your unique code, then click "JOIN NOW" and fill in the registration form to enrol as a Brilliant Member. After successful enrolment, you will be led to the sign in page. Sign in with your newly registered email address and password. Fill in the verification code which will be sent to your registered email address inbox and click "SIGN IN". If your submission was successful, you will be automatically redirected to your Brilliant Member Dashboard and your upgraded Membership Tier will be reflected.​ Please note each unique code is eligible for one-time usage. If your code is invalid or it has been used before, you will not be awarded the fast-track offer. If you have any enquiries or encountered any issues, please contact Brilliant by Langham Membership team at ( info.partnerships@brilliantbylangham.com ) for further support. The Promotion is valid from 01 March 2025 to 31 December 2027, both dates inclusive. For the avoidance of doubt, Eligible Mastercard Cardholders must complete their enrolment in the Promotion by 31 December 2027 (this date inclusive). Eligible Mastercard Cardholders must be an active member of Brilliant by Langham to enjoy the Promotion. The Brilliant by Langham membership upgrade will not be extended to Eligible Mastercard Cardholders who complete their membership registration as a Brilliant by Langham Member out of the Promotion Period. This Promotion is available to holders of World Elite, World, Platinum, Titanium Mastercard cards whose cards were issued in the following markets: China, Hong Kong, Japan, Macao, Mongolia, South Korea, Taiwan, Bangladesh, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, Australia & New Zealand. Eligible Mastercard Cardholders can view their Brilliant by Langham membership card by downloading the Brilliant by Langham mobile app or visit website link: http://www.brilliantbylangham.com to log-in and view your membership number in your member profile. Some Brilliant by Langham benefits are subject to availability. Please check here for the details: (Link: http://www.brilliantbylangham.com/en/about-brilliant ) for details. All the general Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy of the Brilliant by Langham apply. The Brilliant by Langham loyalty programme is governed by terms and conditions that can be found here ( http://www.brilliantbylangham.com/en/programme-terms-conditions ). The restaurant offers a full-fledged menu featuring authentic Spanish home-style dishes and desserts. It is recognized as a pioneer in preserving and celebrating Spanish culinary traditions in Singapore. Inspired by the “meson,” a typical home-style restaurant found in Spanish regions, MLSP opened its first outlet in April 2015 at Boat Quay, along the riverfront.
